snippet.title: ToneTrek – Sneak Peek #2: Sound Effects & Trickier Puzzles!
snippet.description:
Here’s another early look at ToneTrek, our upcoming color-based puzzle game!

This version features:
🎧 Early sound effects (not final)
🎨 Multiple color palettes to explore
🧩 More complex patterns and puzzles

Step through tiles, change their colors, and match the target design — in as few moves as possible.

🔥 Stay tuned — a playable demo is coming soon!

🔗 Learn more: https://darkwatersgames.com/tonetrek
📣 Follow us on Facebook: Dark Waters Games

#ToneTrek #IndieGameDev #PuzzleGame #SneakPeek #ComingSoon
